original_sql:
SELECT emp_no, from_date, salary
FROM salaries
ORDER BY emp_no, from_date
LIMIT 20 OFFSET 2000000

candidates.sql:
SELECT emp_no, from_date, salary
FROM salaries
WHERE (emp_no, from_date) > (
    SELECT emp_no, from_date
    FROM salaries
    ORDER BY emp_no, from_date
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2000000
)
ORDER BY emp_no, from_date
LIMIT 20
candidates.rationale: Uses a subquery to find the boundary row at the offset, then seeks directly to that point in the primary key index to fetch the next 20 rows, avoiding scanning and discarding 2 million rows.
